description: Source code implementing ASN.1 integer and enumerated type serialization functions for OpenSSL, including i2a_ASN1_INTEGER and i2a_ASN1_ENUMERATED.

methods.name: i2a_ASN1_INTEGER
methods.description: Converts ASN1_INTEGER to ASCII and writes to BIO.

methods.name: i2a_ASN1_ENUMERATED
methods.description: Converts ASN1_ENUMERATED to ASCII by calling i2a_ASN1_INTEGER.
